title: Alibi and Will Again
author: Rosalind Joubert
blurb: Theo Lockridge, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
